Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Vibrant Horse Photo Framed Wall Art Decor - 13 x 15 Inch Frame, Rustic Brown
Colors: Multicolor
Materials: paper
Bring a touch of farm life to your interior spaces with this high quality giclee print. It features a full color image of a brown horse looking into the camera as if to say, "I'm ready for my close-up." It comes matted and ready to hang in a brown wood colored frame. 13"W x 15"H Rustic wood colored frame, paper and glass Modern, rustic style Ready to hang, all hardware included
